**B01AE07** is the Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for dabigatran, a direct oral anticoagulant ([[doac|DOAC]]) [^src1] [^src3]. In the Danish healthcare system, this drug code is central to the clinical quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) for patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. Specifically, B01AE07 is tracked under national indicators measuring the quality of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] and the monitoring of kidney function [^src1] [^src2]. 

The code is part of a broader framework of pharmaceutical tracking used to evaluate cardiovascular care. Clinical guidelines define anticoagulation treatment as including [[b01aa|B01AA]] (vitamin K antagonists) as well as the DOACs: B01AE07 (dabigatran), [[b01af01|B01AF01]] (rivaroxaban), [[b01af02|B01AF02]] (apixaban), and [[b01af03|B01AF03]] (edoxaban) [^src1]. By standardizing these ATC codes, RKKP ensures consistent data collection, enabling precise measurement of treatment wait times, diagnostic procedures, and overall care quality across Denmark's regions [^src2] [^src3].
